description: Translation test v2 (docs/na-label-grid-error.md). As v1, but the electronic state is held: each of the 8 shifts (k*h/8, k = 0..7, along x) is its own CP2K single point started from the same converged wavefunction in the legacy label's state (seed.wfn), with the full U from the first SCF step. Seeds: v1 outputs whose shifts kept the label's Fe spins (cubo_puro-q9-c1600 last shift: max |dspin| 0.000; vacancia-q9-c700: 0.001); the Na q1 seed is generated in the job from the unshifted frame with the label protocol. grid_n: finest-grid sizes printed by the v1 outputs.
